title: The $33 Million Teenager Who Beat Venus Williams
description:
Coco Gauff is the highest-paid woman in sports, at 33 million dollars.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Coco Gauff: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coco_Gauff
- Wikipedia: Forbes list of the world's highest-paid female athletes: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_list_of_the_world%27s_highest-paid_female_athletes

From the cited pages: Forbes' 2025 list of the highest-paid female athletes ranks Coco Gauff first with $33.0 million, of which $25 million was endorsements and $8 million winnings; at 15, in 2019, she qualified for Wimbledon and beat five-time champion Venus Williams in straight sets in her Grand Slam main-draw debut; she won the 2023 US Open at 19, beating world No. 2 Aryna Sabalenka after losing the first set, and became the youngest American player to win the US Open final since Serena Williams in 1999; her career prize money is listed as US$37,516,617. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: You're Coco Gauff, the highest-paid woman in sports, at 33 million dollars.
But at 15, you qualify for Wimbledon. Suddenly, you face Venus Williams.
You serve, you rally, and you win in straight sets.
Then at 19, you beat Aryna Sabalenka to win the US Open. You are the youngest American champion since Serena Williams.
Not bad for a 15-year-old who had to qualify for Wimbledon.
